description: Welcome to our exquisite 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom apartment located in the heart of the iconic Champs-Élysées district.There is currently a bit of construction next to the apartment so we want you to be aware.The spaceExquisite apartment located right next to the Champs Elysees : newly refurbished 149sqm located on the 2nd floor with an elevator.Prime Champs-Élysées Location: Immerse yourself in the glamour of Paris with a stay on the world-renowned Champs-Élysées. Enjoy immediate access to high-end boutiques, gourmet restaurants, and the vibrant energy of this celebrated avenue.Elegance and Style: Step into a world of refined elegance as you enter our meticulously designed apartment. Every detail, from the bespoke furnishings to the curated art pieces, reflects a commitment to luxury and comfort.Spacious Living Areas: The generously sized living spaces provide the perfect setting for relaxation and entertainment. Revel in the comfort of plush furnishings, marvel at panoramic city views, or unwind on the private terrace overlooking the Champs-Élysées.Gourmet Kitchen: The state-of-the-art kitchen is a haven for culinary enthusiasts. Equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and sleek countertops, it's the perfect space for creating exquisite meals or enjoying catered delights.Sumptuous 4 Bedrooms and 4 full Bathrooms: Retreat to the opulent bedrooms, each a sanctuary of tranquility. Luxuriate in the lavish bathrooms, featuring designer fixtures, marble accents, and indulgent amenities.
